name: Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI)
teaser: Revenue is up 86% but free cash flow is minus $900 million and new shares paid for it. Base $94 against $100.68, no buy price issued.
llms: Maker of lasers and optical transceivers for AI data centers and cable networks, valued on normalized 2027 EV/EBITDA after the committed 2026 build, a ten-year free cash flow model and a forward P/E cross-check. Bear $23, Base $94, Bull $168. Verdict HOLD at $100.68, do not add. Free cash flow was -$900 million over twelve months and about $1.6 billion of new shares were sold in 2026. Required margin of safety 75%, no maximum buy price issued.
